messages:
zoe-partners: quick huddle 1 planning SI co-sell + marketplace bundling. need one clear ROE for lead claims and HW reservations. target: next sprint.
mark-sales: i'll sweep top-80 accounts tonight and flag any live opps. will add POI tags.
anya-si: rule proposal: SI can claim only if POI>=2 or demo scheduled. also require a short integration blurb attached to claim.
li-hw: dev kit inventory is tight. please include `qty_needed` in the claim so we can reserve. reservation window = 7 business days.
zoe-partners: proposed claim CSV schema:
```
acct_id,acct_name,current_owner,region,stage,si_claim,claim_ts,claim_basis,poi_score,qty_needed,expected_phase
```
mark-sales: add `claim_source` (marketplace|referral|ae) so we track origin.
zoe-partners: good call 1 updated schema.
frank-ops: conflict ladder suggestion: (1) AE with active forecast, (2) SI with signed SOW or POI>=3, (3) marketplace leads. escalate ties to @zoe-partners.
anya-si: SLA: SI to respond to claim within 48h with next-step. if unresponsive, ownership reverts to AE and tag `si_no_response`.
notify-bot: calendar created: "SI pipeline nexus triage" Tue 9:30am PT 1 attendees zoe-partners, mark-sales, anya-si, li-hw.
zoe-partners: action items: mark = sweep + upload CSV, li = publish SKU qty, anya = demo intake link + SE rotation, frank = consolidate ROE doc and loop legal if needed. we'll resolve collisions in the triage. thanks!
